rows.source: Trump sọ pé òun "kò ní fẹ́" láti dá Rosenstein dúró lẹ́nu iṣẹ́ ṣùgbọ́n lẹ́yìn èyí ìpàdé náà di dídá dúró díẹ̀ láti yàgò fún èdè àìyedè pẹ̀lú ìgbìmọ̀ ìdájọ́ Aṣòfin àgbà ní ibi tí Kavanaugh àti ọ̀kan lára àwọn obìnrin tí ó fi ẹ̀sùn ìbálòpọ̀ ní ọ́nà àìtọ́ kan Ọ̀mọ̀wé Christine Blassey Ford, àwọn méjèèjì ló jẹ́ ẹ̀rí
rows.output: Trump said he "doesn't want" to fire Rosenstein but after that meeting, the meeting was briefly delayed to avoid a public confrontation with the Senate Judiciary Committee in the presence of Kavanaugh and one of the women who accused him of sexual misconduct, writer Christine Blasey Ford, both of whom were testifying.

I thought I was destined to be a reformer of public services for those who needed it most - whether as a local councillor or a government minister.

rows.output: But in reality, the only message I have is to Nottingham Momentum, to the wards, or to Labour members or not: I am proud to work for the public and I promise that no type of electoral fraud or political confusion will prevent me from working in what I believe is the best thing for the public.

rows.output: Europe has played a dominant role in the Olympics for years, and it shows no signs of slowing down. However, this fourth quarter is also a time for the United States to shine, especially on home soil.
rows.reference: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.

rows.source: Turai tana ja gaba 10 da 6 a cikin ƙarshen ranan Ryder Cup
rows.output: Europe is leading by 10 with 6 to play in the final round of the Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day

rows.source: Turai za ta sami wata fa’ida mai amfani a cikin ranar ta ƙarshe ta Ryder Cup bayan tasowa daga ƙwallaye huɗu na Asabar da wasannin huɗu-huɗu tare da wani ja gaba na 10 da 6 a cikin Amurka.
rows.output: Europe will have a significant advantage on the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from four-ball on Sunday with four wins and two halved matches, and a 10-6 lead in the singles.
rows.reference: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.

rows.source: Su biyun da suka sami ƙarfin gwiwa Tommy Fleetwood da Francesco Molinari sun jagori canji da cin nasarori biyu a saman Tiger Woods da ke gwagwarmaya don ɗaukan lamba ya zuwa yanzu a Le Golf National zuwa ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu.
rows.output: Both of the previous leaders, Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari, have been overtaken by a resurgent Tiger Woods who is now in contention for the top prize at Le Golf National, four shots clear of the field.
rows.reference: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.

rows.source: Sashen Turai na Thomas Bjorn, mai neman riƙe kofin ba su ci nasara ba a Hazeltine shekaru biyu da suka wuce, da mamaye wani rashin sa’a a sashen Amurka a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu na safe, inda suka ɗauki jere-jere 3 da 1.
rows.output: The European section of Thomas Bjorn, seeking to retain the title, did not win at Hazeltine two years ago, and were overwhelmed by an unfortunate situation in the American section in four morning holes, where they took a 3-1 lead.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.

rows.source: Amurka ta ƙara turjiya a cikin huɗu-huɗun, tana ci nasarar wasanni biyu, amma sun gagara ci a cikin tawayar.
rows.output: The United States won two more matches in the quarterfinals, but they were unable to advance to the semifinals.
rows.reference: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.

rows.source: Sashen Jim Furyk suna buƙatar ɗigo-ɗigo daga wasanni ɗaiɗaiku 12 na ranar Lahadi don riƙe kofin.
rows.output: The Jim Furyk Group needs a hole-in-one from each of the 12 holes on Sunday to maintain their title.
rows.reference: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Fleetwood shi ne farkon rookie na Turai da ya ci ɗigo-ɗigo huɗu a yayin da shi da Molinari, da aka cewa "Molliwood" bayan wani ƙarshen mako da ake magana kuma kawai su ne haɗin biyu da suka ci ɗigo-ɗigo hudu daga budewa wasanninsu huɗu a cikin tarihin Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Fleetwood was the first European rookie to win four holes in a row during the opening round, along with Molinari, who was dubbed "Molliwood" after a weekend conversation. They were the only pair to win four holes from the start of their four matches in the history of the Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.

rows.source: Bayan sun buge Woods da Patrick Reed a cikin ƙwallaye huɗun sai kuma suka tashi suke buge Woods da rookie na Amurka Bryson Dechambeau ta kuma wani abin gani na 5 da 4.
rows.output: After hitting Woods and Patrick Reed in a three-ball match, they then rose to hit Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by another 5-hole 4.
rows.reference: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.

rows.source: Woods, wanda ya ja kansa zuwa cikin wasanni biyu a ranar Asabar, ya nuna wata bayyana ta ilimi amma yanzu ya rasa 19 na wasanninsa a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da wasannin huɗu-huɗu da bakwai a cikin wani jeri.
rows.output: Woods, who has played in two games on Sunday, has shown a sign of intelligence but now has lost 19 of his games in four corners and four in a row in a row.
rows.reference: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.

rows.source: Justin Rose, ya huta don ƙwallaye huɗu na safen, ya dawo ga abokin hulɗa Henrik Stenson a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu zuwa ga wata dokewa 2 da 1 ci na Dustin Johnson da Brooks Koepka - mai kima ɗaya da uku a cikin duniya.
rows.output: Justin Rose, who had already carded four bogeys, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the four-ball match against Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - a three-stroke lead in the world rankings.
rows.reference: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.

rows.source: Turai ba ta samu ba yadda take da sauki, ranar kudu-maso-yamma mai iska ta Paris.
rows.output: Europe has not had as easy a time as we did, the southern summer day of Paris.
rows.reference: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.

rows.source: Babban mai cin nasara sau uku Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas sun kafa wani layi don Amurkawa tare da ɗigo-ɗigo biyu a ranar Asabar.
rows.output: Three-time major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set up an all-American final round with two-under-par 70s on Sunday.
rows.reference: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.

rows.source: Sun sami wani ci da ba daɗi na 2 da 1 a kan Jon Rahm Ian Poulter na Spain a cikin ƙwallaye huɗu da kuma dawowa daga baya don buge Poulter da Rory McIlroy 4 da 3 a cikin wasannin huɗu-huɗu bayan su rasa cin nasara ta buɗewa ramukan biyu.
rows.output: They had a disappointing score of 2 and 1 against Jon Rahm Ian Poulter of Spain in four holes and then came back to beat Poulter with Rory McIlroy 4 and 3 in foursome matches after losing the opening hole.
rows.reference: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.

rows.source: Kawai sau ɗaya ne a tarihin Ryder Cup wata ƙungiya ta sake dawowa daga wani rasa ɗigo huɗu a cikin ɗaiɗaiku,  kodayake kamar yadda masu riƙon na sashen Furyk ke buƙatar kawai tsayuwar doki don riƙe kofin.
rows.output: Only once in the history of the Ryder Cup has a team come back from a four-hole deficit in singles, and it was as if the members of the Furyk team needed only a horse to hold the trophy.
rows.reference: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.

rows.source: Bayan kasancewa na biyu mafi kyau na kwanaki biyu, amma, wani sake hari na ranar Lahadi ya yi kamar dai zai fi ƙarfinsu.
rows.output: After two days of being the second-best player, however, a sudden attack on Sunday looked like it would surpass them both.
rows.reference: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce ‘ba yadda’ za ta rage makami ita kaɗai ba tare da aminci ba
rows.output: North Korea says that it will not disarm without corresponding measures from the United States.
rows.reference: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust

rows.source: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa ya faɗa wa Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Asabar ci gaba da takunkumi yana ƙara tura rashin amincewarta da Amurka kuma babu wata hanya da ƙasar za ta bar makamanta na nukiliya ita kaɗai a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin.
rows.output: The North Korean Foreign Minister told the United Nations Security Council on Saturday that the continued sanctions are increasing the country's isolation and that there is no way for the country to leave its nuclear status alone under any circumstances.
rows.reference: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.

rows.source: Ri Yong ya faɗa wa Babban Taro na shekara na na hukumar duniya cewa Koriya ta Arewa ta yi “masu matakai na mutunci” a cikin shekarar ta da wuce, kamar tsaida gwaje-gwajen nukiliya da makamai masu linzami, rusa wurin gwajin nukiliya, kuma da yin alkawari ba za ta ƙara makaman nukiliya da fasahar nukiliya ba.
rows.output: Ri Yong told the UN General Assembly that North Korea had taken "prudent and responsible steps" in the previous year, such as stopping nuclear tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to further develop nuclear weapons or technology.
rows.reference: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.

rows.source: "Amma, ba mu ga kowane abu na martani daga Amurka,” inji shi.
rows.output: "But we haven't heard back from the U.S. government," he said.
rows.reference: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.

rows.source: “Ba tare da kowane aminci ba na Amurka ba za a sami ƙarfin gwiwa a cikin tsaronmu na ƙasa kuma a ƙarƙashin ire-iren yanayin babu wata hanya da mu kaɗai za mu rage makamai mu da farko.”
rows.output: Without the security of America, there will be no strength in our defense of the homeland and under various circumstances, there is no way we can reduce our weapons first.
rows.reference: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."

rows.source: A yayin da Rike same maimaita koke-koken Koriya ta Kudu da aka sani game da ƙin Washington na bin wata hanyar “a hankali” don rage makaman nukiliyat a ƙarƙashinsa da za a ba da kyauta ga Koriya ta Arewan a yayin da ɗauki wasu matakai a hankali, jawabin nasa ya bayyana da muhimmanci saboda ba ta ƙi rage makaman nukiliyar ita kaɗai ba haka kawai kamar yadda Pyongyang ɗin ta yi a baya ba.
rows.output: While Rike repeated the familiar South Korean argument that Washington's approach to denuclearization should be "gradual" and that it should offer "rewards" to North Korea, his statement emphasized the importance of this because it was not just a matter of South Korea's demand for denuclearization alone, but also because Pyongyang had previously made similar demands.
rows.reference: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.

rows.source: Ri ya yi dube ne ga wani jawabin hadin gwiwa daga Kim Jong Un da Donald Trump a wani babban taro da aka taba yi tsakanin shugaban Amurka mai ci da wani shugaban Koriya ta Arewa a cikin Singapore a ranar 12 ga Yuni, a lokacin da Kim ya yi alkawari yin aiki zuwa ga "rage makaman nukiliya a zirin Koriya" a lokacin da Trump ya yi alkawarin ba da garanti na tsaron Koriya ta Arewa din.
rows.output: He looked on as Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump gave a joint address at a summit that had previously been held between the incumbent US president and the leader of North Korea in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work towards "denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula" while Trump promised to provide a guarantee of North Korea's security.
rows.reference: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa tana neman wani kawo wa ƙarshen Yakin Koriya na shekarun 1950 zuwa 53, amma Amurkan ta ce Pyongyang dole ta bar makamanta na nukiliya daga farko.
rows.output: North Korea was seeking a guarantee to end the Korean War of 1950-53, but the US insisted that Pyongyang must first abandon its nuclear weapons.
rows.reference: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.

rows.source: Haka kuma Washington ta ki kiraye-kiraye na ta sassauta takunkumin ƙasa-da-ƙasa a kan Koriya ta Arewa.
rows.output: Also, Washington rejected the repeated calls to relax the restrictions on North Korea.
rows.reference: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.

rows.source: “Amurka ta jajirce a kan “barin nukiliya daga farko” kuma ta ƙara matakin matsai ta takunkumi don cimma manufarta a cikin halin tilastawa, da kuma ma ƙin “furuci na ƙarshen yaƙi,”” inji Ri.
rows.output: The United States has been steadfast in its commitment to "first use" of nuclear weapons and has increased the level of threat to achieve its objectives in a coercive manner, and with the "language of the endgame," said Ri.
rows.reference: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.

rows.source: “Fahimta ta cewa takunkumi zai iya kawo mu kan gwiwowinmu wani mafarki ne na mutane waɗanda suka zahilci abu game da mu.
rows.output: She said that the sanctions would only make things worse for the people of South Sudan.
rows.reference: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.

rows.source: Amma matsalar ita ce ci gaba da takunkumi suna kara rashin yardarmu.”
rows.output: But the problem is that the continuous restrictions are only adding to our frustration.”
rows.reference: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."

rows.source: Ri bai yi furuci na shirye-shirye don wani babban taro na biyu tsakanin Kim da Trump wanda shugaban Amurka da ya tsokaci a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a cikin farkon makon.
rows.output: The president did not make any preparations for a second meeting between Kim and Trump, who was criticized by the UN Security Council in the early week.
rows.reference: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.

rows.source: A maimakon haka ministan ya yi tsokaci ne na taruka uku tsakanin Kim da shugaban Koriya ta Kudu Moon Jae-in a cikin watanni biyar da suka wuce kuma ya ƙara da cewa: “Idan kasar da ke cikin wannan batun na barin nukiliya za a ce Koriya ta Kudu ne ba Amurka ba da barin nukiliyar na zirin Koriya da ba sami irin matsalar ba.”
rows.output: Instead, the minister made a three-party meeting between Kim and South Korean President Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added that: "If the country involved in this issue allows nuclear weapons to be left behind, it will be said that South Korea is not the United States leaving nuclear weapons, but South Korea leaving nuclear weapons without a problem."
rows.reference: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."

rows.source: Duk da haka, lafazin jawabin na Ri ya dan zama daban daga na shekarar da ta gabata, a lokacin da ya gaya wa Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar cewa cikin yankin Amurka da rokokin Koriya wani abu ne da dole zai wakana bayan “Mista Shugaba Mai Neman Bala’i” Trup ya kira Kim da wani “mutum mai roka” da ke neman kashe kansa.
rows.output: However, the tone of Ri's statement was somewhat different from that of the previous year, when he told the General Assembly of the United Nations that the North American and Korean rockets were something that had to be addressed after "Mr. President Seeking Salvation" Trup called Kim a "rocket man" who was seeking to destroy himself.
rows.reference: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.

rows.source: Wannan shekarar a Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, Trump, wanda shekarar da ta gabata ya yi barazana ta “rusa gaba ɗaya” Koriya ta Arewa, ya yabi Kim don karfin halinsa na ɗaukan matakai na rage makamai, amma ya ce har yanzu a akwai aiki da dole za a yi kuma takunkumi suna nan sa har Koriya ta Arewan ta bar nukiliya.
rows.output: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who the previous year had threatened to "completely destroy" North Korea, praised Kim for his commitment to denuclearization, but said that there was still more work to be done and that sanctions would remain in place until North Korea completely dismantled its nuclear arsenal.
rows.reference: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.

rows.source: A ranar Laraba, Trump ya ce ba ya da lokaci ƙayyadedde don wannan, yana cewa “Idan zai ɗauki shekaru biyu, shekaru uku ko shekaru biyar - ba damuwa.”
rows.output: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a specific timeline for this, saying “If it takes two years, three years, or five years - no problem.”
rows.reference: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."

rows.source: China da Rasha sun yi mahawara cewa ya kamata Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya ba da kyauta ga Pyongyang don matakan da ta ɗauka.
rows.output: China and Russia have argued that the UN Security Council should grant a waiver to Pyongyang for the measures it has taken.
rows.reference: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.

rows.source: Amma, Sakataren Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka  Mike Pompeo ya faɗa wa Kwamitin Tsaro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a ranar Alhamis cewa: “Dole tilasta takunkumin Kwamitin Tsaro ya ci gaba sosai ba tare da gazawa ba sai har mun ga cikekken barin nukiliya da aka tantance daga ƙarshe.”
rows.output: However, US Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the UN Security Council on Thursday that: "The sanctions committee must continue to impose sanctions in full force without exception until we see a complete, verified denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula."
rows.reference: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."

rows.source: Kwamitin Tsaro gaba daya ya sa karfafa takunkumi ne a kan Koriya ta Arewa tun 2006 a wani yinkuri na dakile samun kudi don shirye-shiryen Pyongyang na nukiliya da makamin fashewa mai linzami.
rows.output: The entire Security Council imposed sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in an effort to curb funding for Pyongyang's nuclear programs and ballistic missile development.
rows.reference: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.

rows.source: Pompeo ya haɗu da Ri a gefen Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya inda ya ce bayan hakan zai sake ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu.
rows.output: Pompeo met with Ri on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly where he said after that he would visit Pyongyang again in the coming weeks to prepare for a second summit.
rows.reference: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.

rows.source: Pompeo ya ziyarci Koriya ta Arewa sau uku tun tuni wannan shekarar, amma zuwan nasa bai yi daɗi sosai ba.
rows.output: Pompeo has visited South Korea three times this year, but his trip has been overshadowed by controversy.
rows.reference: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.

rows.source: Ya bar Pyongyang a cikin Yuli yana mai cewa an samu ci gaba, kawai sai dai a cikin sa’o’i Koriya ta Arewa ta yi watsi da neman “buƙatu kamar na 'yan daba.”
rows.output: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only to be ignored by North Korea in its request for "demands like those of a hostage."
rows.reference: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."

rows.source: Koriya ta Arewa ta yi alkawari a wani mitin tare da Moon wannan watan za ta ruguza wani wuri na gwajin makami mai linzami da kuma wani gini na nukiliya idan Amurka ta ɗauki “wasu matakai ta ɓangaren.”
rows.output: North Korea has promised in a statement with the Moon this month that it will destroy a site for testing a nuclear weapon and a nuclear facility if the United States takes "corresponding measures."
rows.reference: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."

rows.source: Ya ce Kim ya faɗa masa "wasu matakai ta ɓangaren" da yake nema su ne garanti na tsaro da Trump ya yi alkawari a Singapore da kuma yin motsi zuwa ga daidaita hulɗoɗi tare da Washington.
rows.output: He said Kim had told him "some steps" that he was looking for were a guarantee of security that Trump had promised in Singapore and moving towards a balanced relationship with Washington.
rows.reference: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.

rows.source: Daliban Harvard sun ɗauki kwas a kan samun isasshen barci
rows.output: Harvard students take sleep seriously
rows.reference: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest

rows.source: Wani sabon kwas a Jami’ar Harvard wannan shekarar ya samar wa dukkan ɗalibansa samun ƙarin barci a cikin wani yinƙuri na dakile girman al’adar ƙarti ta karatu ta hanyar shan kafen ‘dukkan dare.’
rows.output: A new study at Harvard University this year found that all students had increased sleep duration in an attempt to curb the growing culture of caffeine use through late-night studying.
rows.reference: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'

rows.source: Wani malami ya sami ɗalibai a jami’a ta daya a duniyar yawanci ba su san kome ba idan an zo maganar muhimman abubuwa game da yadda za su kula da kansu.
rows.output: A university professor had students in one class who were mostly unaware of the importance of things when it came to how to take care of themselves.
rows.reference: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, farfesa na maganin barci a Makarantar Koyon Aikin Likita ta Harvard kuma wani kwararre a Brigham da Asibitin Mata, shi ne ya tsara kwas din, wanda ya yi imani shi ne na farko irinsa a cikin Amurka.
rows.output: Charles Czeisler, a professor of sleep medicine at the Harvard Medical School and a specialist at Brigham and Women's Hospital, was the first to develop the sleep study, which he believed to be the first of its kind in the United States.

rows.output: He was inspired to start donating blood after giving a talk on the effects of sleep deprivation on learning.

rows.source: ‘Daga ƙarshe wata yarinya guda ɗaya ta zo ta same ni ta ce: ‘Me ya sa sai yanzu aka gaya mun wannan, a cikin shekarata ta karshe?’
rows.output: Finally, one young woman came up to me and said, "What is it that you are hiding from us? Why are you telling us this now, in the last year of my life?"
rows.reference: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'

rows.source: Ta ce ba wanda ya taɓa gaya mata game da amfani na barci - abin da ya ba ta mamaki,’ ta faɗa wa The Telegraph.
rows.output: She said that no one had ever told her about the use of sleep - which was quite surprising,' she told The Telegraph.

rows.source: Kwas ɗin ya fara ne yin lokacin farko a wannan shekarar, inda aka yi bayani ga dalibai fa’idoji na yadda halaye masu kyau na barci ke taimakon aikin koyon ilimi da wasan tsalle-tsalle, har ma da inganta lafiyarsu gaba ɗaya.
rows.output: The program began by spending the first time this year, explaining to students the benefits of good sleep habits on learning and jumping activities, even improving their overall health.
rows.reference: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.

rows.output: Paul Barreira, a professor of psychiatry at the Harvard Medical School and the senior director of the school's health services, said the school made the decision to provide condoms after it found that students were very reluctant to sleep during the week.

rows.output: But we believe that they have the freedom to know - just as you have the freedom to know the ill effects of smoking,' Professor Czeisler added.

rows.output: The tradition of sleeping in a 'cold room' every night is still there, he says, adding that the advanced technology and the constant pressure on students means that sleep is becoming a major problem.

rows.output: It is important to ensure that you are getting enough sleep, as this can help to prevent fatigue, irritability, and depression.
rows.reference: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.

rows.output: He hopes the next step, will seek out all students of the postgraduate program after graduation to fill in the preparatory study program before entering a competitive university.

rows.output: Professor Czeisler suggested that students should maintain a regular sleep schedule, even on weekends, and be aware of the negative effects of "blue light" from electronic devices and LED lights, which can disrupt their natural sleep-wake cycle and lead to sleep disorders.

rows.source: Livingston 1 da Rangers 0: Cin Menga ya ƙasƙantar da mutanen Gerrard
rows.output: Livingston 1, Rangers 0: Menga's Strike Leaves Gerrard's Side Reeling
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers ta sami koma baya a lokacin da harin Dolly Menga ya taƙaita gefen Steven Gerrard da ya rabu zuwa ga ci 1 da 0 a Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers suffered a setback during the match when Dolly Menga's shot forced Steven Gerrard to split and score 1-0 at Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Gefen Ibrox suna neman su samar da cinsu na farko ne a kan hanyar tun cin nasara ta 4 da 1 a Fabarairu a St Johnstone, amma ƙungiyar Gary Holt ta janyo doke kawai  Gerrard karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 games a matsayin manaja inda ya bar gefensa da ɗigo-ɗigo takwas a ruguje kan hanyar Ladbrokes shugabannin Hearts na Premiership.
rows.output: Ibrox side are seeking their first win since a 4-1 victory over St Johnstone in February, but Gary Holt's team has only managed to secure a second goal in 18 games as manager, leaving them with eight defeats on the way to Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga sun kai harin ne mintina bakwai kafin rabin lokaci kuma wani bugun gajeren layi na Rangers din a kan jan hankali da bai taɓa kama da yin lebur.
rows.output: Menga scored the opening goal seven minutes before half-time and Rangers' substitute, who had been making a nuisance of himself, was booked for dissent.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Yayin da Rangers yanzu ta sauka ƙasa zuwa ga matsayi na shida, Livingston kuwa ta hau sama ne zuwa ta uku kuma kawai a bayan Hibernian a kan ci na bambanci.
rows.output: While Rangers have now dropped down to sixth place, Livingston has climbed up to third place and are only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Kuma za a iya samun ƙarin tashin hankali a ajiye ga Rangers bayan da sai da aka yi jinyar mai lura da layi Calum Spence na wani raunin ka bayan da a bayyane aka jefo wani abu daga ƙarshen wurin.
rows.output: And further tension can be found in the Rangers camp after the treatment of linesman Calum Spence for a broken leg, which was clearly thrown from the end of the pitch.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi canje-canje takwas zuwa ga ɓangaren wanda ya jefa Ayr cikin wasannin kafin ƙarshe na Kofin Betfred.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes to the side that had beaten Ayr in the previous round of the Betfred Cup.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, a wani ɓangaren, ya tafi tare da irin Livi 11 ɗin wanda ta cire ɗigo daga Hearts mako da wuce kuma da ya yi murna da irin yadda waɗanda ya horar suka wahalar da masu adawarsu a kowane juyin da aka yi.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, went with the Livi 11s, who removed a digo from Hearts a week ago and were delighted with the way their trainees troubled their opponents in each turn.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Za a kila ce Rangers sun mamaye kame ƙwallon amma Livingston sun yi abubuwa da yawa da ƙwallon da suka samu.
rows.output: Rangers may have been in possession of the ball, but Livingston were doing a great job of winning it back.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ya kamata a ce sun ci kawai a mintina biyu na farawa lokacin musayar Menga ta farko da ta aika Scott Pittman ta cikin cin Allan McGregor amma mai tsaron tsakiya ya faɗaɗa damarsa babba sosai.
rows.output: It should be said that they only scored in the first two minutes of the first exchange of Menga's first pass to Scott Pittman, but goalkeeper Allan McGregor widened the gap significantly.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Wani dukan da ba tarewa na Keaghan Jacobs sai ya sami gola Craig Halkett amma abokinsa mai tsaro Alan Lithgow ya iya kawai faɗaɗawa ne a bayan matsayar.
rows.output: The ball was played by Keaghan Jacobs, but it was caught by Craig Halkett, and his teammate, goalkeeper Alan Lithgow, was only able to clear it from the goal.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers ta dai kama sarrafa amma akwai alamar ƙarin fata maimakon yarda game da wasansu a ukun ƙarshe.
rows.output: Rangers were in control for much of the game, but they were unable to score a decisive goal.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos ba shakka ya ji ya kamata a ce ya sami wani bugu daga kai sai gola a makin kashi na uku na rabin sa’a kamar yadda shi da Steven Lawless suka yi karo amma alƙalin wasa Steven Thomson ya manta koke-koke na Colombia.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos was clearly deserving of a penalty from a foul by him and Steven Lawless in the third minute of injury time, but referee Steven Thomson forgot to award Colombia a penalty.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers ta yi ƙoƙarin kawai buge-buge na rabin farko na biyu a kan abin hari amma tsohon golan Ibrox Liam Kelly bai nuna wata damuwa ba daga bugun kai na Lassana Coulibaly da kuma wani harin sauri na Ovie Ejaria.
rows.output: Rangers tried to force a half-time equaliser in the second half on the break but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly showed no concern from Lassana Coulibaly's header and another swift shot from Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Yayin da buɗin da Livi ta samu na mintina 34 kila ya zama a kan sake wasa, ba wanda zai iya ƙi sun cancance shi don cinsu da kawai suka samu.
rows.output: While the opening of Livi for 34 minutes may have been enough to earn a replay, no one can deny that they deserved their victory with only the points they earned.
rows.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

rows.source: Rangers sun sake kasa magance wani hoɓɓasa da Jacobs ya yi.
rows.output: Rangers were unable to solve another Jacobs puzzle.

rows.output: Scott Arfield did not respond as Declan Gallagher passed the ball to Scott Robinson, who took Menga's shot in a small corner.

rows.source: Gerrard ya yi aiki a hutun inda ya sauya Coulibaly da Ryan Kent kuma sauyi ya kusan samar da wani tasirin nan da nan a matsayin mai kai hari ta kusurwa na sakun da ka yi wa Morelos amma mai ban sha’awa Kelly ya yi gudu daga layinsa don ya toshe.
rows.output: Gerrard worked in the break where he replaced Coulibaly and Ryan Kent and the change almost had an immediate impact as a left-sided winger in the 20th minute against Morelos but the exciting Kelly was caught out of position to block.

rows.output: But Livingston continued to lure visitors to the genuine game they were enjoying, with Lithgow and Halkett getting a long ball in the air behind the long ball.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Ɓangaren Holt da sun faɗaɗa matsayinsu na gaba a cikin matakan ƙarshe amma McGregor ya tsaya sosai ya hana Jacobs kafin Lithgow ya yi bugun ka daga kwanar.
rows.output: The Holt section had extended their lead in the final standings but McGregor was so far ahead that he was able to hold off Jacobs before Lithgow scored a goal from the corner.

rows.output: Rangers' replacement winger Glenn Middleton scored a late penalty attempt in an effort to catch up with Jacobs, but Thomson diverted it.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.output: And now, a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, we are also CELEBRATING ... the birthday of the meteorologist who would later become the most beloved, Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger in Germany.

rows.output: Geiger built a method for detecting and measuring the effects of radiation, a device that led to the creation of the instrument known as the Geiger Counter.

rows.output: Another vaccine trial showed positive results in patients who received the vaccine at least four weeks before the start of the pandemic.

rows.source: Mata ɗaya da aka yi wa jinya da allurar, da ke koyar da tsarin kariyar jikin don gano sel-sel masu matsalar, ta ga sankararta ta mahaifa ta bace na fiye da watanni 18.
rows.output: A woman who received an injection of the vaccine, which teaches the body's immune system to recognize problematic cells, has seen her mother's cancerous tumour disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.reference: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.

rows.source: Hanyar ta hada ne da cirowa sel-sel na kariyar jiki daga wani marar lafiya, inda ake gyara su a cikin dakin gwajin kimiyya yadda za su iya “ganin” wani sinadarin protein mai gina jiki da sankarori masu yawa suka sani da ake kira HER2, inda kuma ake sake shigar da su sel-sel din.
rows.output: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, repairing them in a laboratory so that they can "see" a protein construct known as HER2, and then reintroducing the cells into the patient.
rows.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

rows.output: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our findings suggest that there is a vaccine that will help."
rows.reference: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."

rows.output: Professor Berzofsky said that HERS would "generate a wide range of different types of tumors," including breast, uterus, lungs, and liver.
rows.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

rows.source: An yi amfani da irin hanyar ta ɗaukan sel-sel da jikin marassa lafiya da "koyar" da su yadda za su kai hari ga sel-sel na sankara kuma ya yi aiki a wajen jinyar irin cutar fara.
rows.output: The method was used to take cells from healthy people and "teach" them to attack cancer cells and it worked in the treatment of a particular type of leukemia.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi cin tara akan “ɓata masa halaye na dabi'a, a cikin adadin da ya dace da nauyin laifin, wanda yakan iya zama mafi tsananin cin zarafin haƙin ɗan adam a cikin shekarun nan.”
rows.output: Attorney Christian Schertz said the player will seek compensation for "the moral depravity, in the amount corresponding to the weight of the offense, which can be the most severe violation of human rights in recent years."

rows.output: After meeting at a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga allegedly returned to the player's room, where they were accused of having sex in a bed, according to the documents filed in the Clark County Court in Nevada.

rows.source: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci
rows.output: Brexit: UK 'har abada zata yi da na sanin' rasa masu kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers

rows.source: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.
rows.output: The UK "will always be a major player in the automotive industry" even if it does not maintain its current position after Brexit, said Secretary of State for Business Greg Clark.
rows.reference: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.

rows.source: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.
rows.output: He added that it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal, it would temporarily sell work from its Derby plant.
rows.reference: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.
rows.output: "We need a deal," Mr. Clark said.

rows.output: A Japanese car company says the impact of a hard Brexit on the border with Ireland is likely to be so severe that it could lose production.
rows.reference: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.

rows.source: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.
rows.output: The Burnaston plant, which manufactures the Toyota Auris and Avensis, has produced around 150,000 vehicles per year, with 90% of these exports going to other European countries.
rows.reference: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.

rows.source: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.output: "I see it as if Britain leaves the EU in March we will have a surge in demand for our exports," saidavin Cooke, Managing Director of Toyota at Burnaston.
rows.reference: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.

rows.source: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Some UK carmakers have expressed concern about leaving the EU without a deal on how the car industry's cross-border trade would function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, for example, has said that it will close its small Oxford factory for a month after Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.

rows.source: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.
rows.output: The main concern is related to what the car manufacturers have said regarding the risk of having production facilities if there is a Brexit without a deal.
rows.reference: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.

rows.source: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.
rows.output: Toyota's production control system is based on the "just-in-time" principle, where parts arrive in 37-minute intervals from suppliers in the UK and EU for assembly line production.
rows.reference: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.

rows.source: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.
rows.output: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be problems at the border that the industry says could lead to delays and shortages.

rows.source: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.

rows.source: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.
rows.output: “We need a deal. We want the best deal possible. We want to be able to compete and succeed in the global economy, and we want to be able to provide for our families and communities. We need a deal that allows us to do that,” he said on BBC Radio 4’s Today program.

rows.reference: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.

rows.source: O kwuru na mmụta ahụ mepere anya ya wee kpalite echiche ya ịkwanye ka mmụta a bụrụ maka ụlọ akwụkwọ niile.
rows.output: He said that the education opened his eyes and inspired him to make the education available for all schools.
rows.reference: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.

rows.source: Nke na-esote ya, ọ na-enwe olile anya ịrịọ ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị gụchagoro mmụta izizi ka ha mejuputa mmụta yitebere nke a tupu ha abanye n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ.
rows.output: Following that, he hopes to request graduates of the first degree to implement the knowledge acquired in the program before entering the school.
rows.reference: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.

rows.source: Ọkammụta Czeisler kwadoro ka ụmụ akwụkwọ chee banyere itinye otimkpu maka mgbe ha chọrọ ịrahụ ụra, yana mgbe ha chọrọ ikuli, ma marakwa maka nsonazụ mmerụ ahụ ihuenyo ngwa eletrọnịk “ihie agba elu igwe” na-ebute yana ihie LED, nke nwere ike kụpụ usoro ka ahụ gị si akpa agwa, we bute nsogbu ịrahụ ụra.
rows.output: Professor Czeisler suggested that students consider setting an alarm for when they wanted to get up, and when they wanted to go to bed, and be aware of the consequences of the "high-intensity light-emitting device" (electronic screen) on your body's internal clock, which can disrupt your sleep patterns and lead to sleep disorders.
rows.reference: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.

rows.source: Livingston 1-0 Rangers: Goolu Menga buturu ndị nke Gerrard
rows.output: Livingston 1-0 Rangers: Goal by Menga, assisted by Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men

rows.source: Rangers natara ihe mgbu ka ọgbụgba Dolly Menga kwanyere akụkụ Steven Gerrard ghasara aghasa na mmeri 1-0 emeriri ha na Livingston.
rows.output: Rangers received a blow as Dolly Menga's header hit Steven Gerrard's knee in a 1-0 defeat to Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.

rows.source: Akụkụ Ibrox ahụ na-achọ inweta mmeri nke izizi ha n’ụzọ kemgbe ha meriri 4-1 na Febuarị na St Johnstone, mana ndị otu Gary Holt nyere Gerrard mmeri nke abụọ emeriri ha n’egwuregwu 18 dịka onye njikwa jiri akara asatọ esegharị n’elu nke ndị mbu na Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.
rows.output: The Ibrox side is looking for their first win since their 4-1 victory over St Johnstone in February, but Gary Holt's team gave Gerrard his second defeat in 18 games as the manager marked his eighth win in the top league, Hearts.
rows.reference: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.

rows.source: Menga jiri tupu nkeji asaa nke ọkara oge were gbanye ọkpụ, na ndị Rangers n’enweghị mkpalite mmụọ adịghị ka ndị ga-agbanyekwa nke ha.
rows.output: Menga took just over seven minutes to score, and the Rangers, who were in desperate need of a win, were unable to respond.
rows.reference: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.

rows.source: Ebe ndị Rangers gbadara na ndị nke isii, Linvingston gbagoro na ndị nke atọ ma jiri ndịiche dị na goolu nọrọ naanị n’azụ Hibernian.
rows.output: The Rangers fell to sixth place, while Livingston rose to third place and maintained a goal difference with Hibernian.
rows.reference: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.

rows.source: Na enwere ike inwe nsogbu n’ọdịnihu maka ndị Rangers ka agwọchara onye na-akwụ n’akụkụ Calum Spencem merụ ahụ n’isi, mgbe atụchara ihe si n’akụkụ nke ndị ọbịa.
rows.output: There could be future problems for Rangers as Calum Spence, who was injured in the corner, is likely to miss the next game after being hit by something from the corner of the visitors.
rows.reference: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.

rows.source: Gerrard mere mgbanwe asatọ n’akụkụ nke gbafere Ayr were banye n’agba na-esote nke ikpeazụ nke Iko Betfred.
rows.output: Gerrard made eight changes on the side that crossed Ayr and entered the next round of the final Betfred Cup.
rows.reference: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.

rows.source: Holt, n’aka nke ya, jiri otu 11 Livi wee gaa, nke napụrụ ndị Hearts otu akara izu gara aga, na ọ gaara ịmasịkwa ya otu ndị nke ya gbasiri ike siri sogide ndị iro ha n’ebe niile.
rows.output: Holt, on the other hand, used an 11 Livi and went, which had previously taken a point from Hearts the previous week, and it would also be interesting to see how his own strong team would fare against their rivals in all directions.
rows.reference: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.

rows.source: Rangers nwere ike bụrụ ndị kacha jide bọọlụ mana Livingston kacha jiri bọọlụ ha nwetere wee mere ihe.
rows.output: Rangers could be the ones to hold the ball but Livingston were the ones to make the most of the ball they had and score.
rows.reference: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.

rows.source: Ha kwesịrị iji nkeji abụọ ha jiri banye nye goolu mgbe obere ọkpụkpa izizi nke Menga mere zipuru Scott Pittman na goolu nke Allan McGrego, mana onye nke ahụ na-agba n’etiti gbafuru nnukwu oghere ya.
rows.output: They should have used their two minutes to score a goal after a small mistake by Menga, but Scott Pittman's shot was wide and Allan McGregor's goal was missed, leaving a big gap.
rows.reference: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.

rows.source: Ọgbụgba Keaghan Jacobs mere zutere onye na-eche goolu Craig Halkett mana onye mgbachibido otu ya Alan Lithgow nwere naanị ike ịgbafu ya n’azụ.
rows.output: Keaghan Jacobs' throw was met by goalkeeper Craig Halkett, but his teammate Alan Lithgow was only able to clear it.
rows.reference: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.

rows.source: Rangers nwetara njikwa mana ọ dịka enwere olile anya karịa ka enwere nkwenye ka otu ha si agba na ngwucha nke atọ.
rows.output: Rangers won the management, but it seemed that there was more hope than acceptance as they played in the final third.
rows.reference: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos chere na ọ kwesịrị ịgba penaliti n’akara nkeji iri na ise ka ya na Steven Lawless kụtara mana onye njikwa egwuregwu Steven Thomson lefere mkpesa onye Columbia ahụ anya.
rows.output: Alfredo Morelos believed that he deserved to take a penalty in the 15th minute after being fouled by Steven Lawless, but the referee, Steven Thomson, ignored the Colombian's appeal.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.

rows.source: Rangers gbalịrị naanị ịgbata na postu ugboro abụọ n’ọkara nke mbu mana onye na-echeburu ndị Ibrox goolu Liam Kelly enweghị ihe mmekpa ahụ ọ bụla na nke Lassana Coulibaly jiri isi kụọ yana ọgbụgba adaghị ụda Ovie Ejaria gbara.
rows.output: Rangers tried to force their way into the post only twice in the first half, but Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was untroubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and Ovie Ejaria's shot was blazed over.
rows.reference: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.

rows.source: Ebe goolu nkeji 34th ndị Livi gbara nwere ike bụrụ ndapụta, ọ nweghị onye ga-ekwu na ọ dabarọ ha naanị maka mbọ ha gbara.
rows.output: The 34th-minute goal by Livi could be considered a gift, but no one will say that it was only for their efforts.
rows.reference: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.

rows.source: Ọzọkwa Rangers enweghị ike metụta ọkpụkpa Jacob miri emi.
rows.output: In addition, Rangers were unable to inflict serious damage on Jacob.
rows.reference: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.

rows.source: Scott Arfield enweghị ihe ọ mere ka Declan Gallagher gbanyere Scott Robinson bọọlụ, bụ onye dara juu were họrọ Menga maka ịgbachapụ ya.
rows.output: Scott Arfield has nothing to do with Declan Gallagher's foul on Scott Robinson, who fell and chose Menga to replace him.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.

rows.source: Gerrard megharịrị na oge ezumike dị ka o jiri Ryan Kent gbanwee Coulibaly nke metụrụ mmetụta ozugbo, ka onye nke na-agba n’akụkụ fanyere Morelos mana Kelly na-agba nke ọma gbara ọsọ site na ebe ọ nọ bịa gbochie.
rows.output: Gerrard adapted in the break as he used Ryan Kent to replace Coulibaly, who had an immediate impact, as the left winger entered Morelos but Kelly was effectively blocked by a run from where he was to prevent him.
rows.reference: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.

rows.source: Mana Livingston gara n’ihu ime ka ndị ọbịa ahụ na-agba ụdị egwuregwu na-amasị ha, ebe Lithgow na Halkett na-agba bọọlụ ote aka kwa mgbe.
rows.output: But Livingston continued to insist that the guests play the kind of games they enjoyed, while Lithgow and Halkett played catch every time.
rows.reference: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.

rows.source: Akụkụ Holt kaara ịgbatị mmeri ha n’oge ikpeazụ mana McGregor kwuchiri wee jụ Jacobs, tupu Lithgow ewere isi kụpụ bọọlụ n’akụkụ.
rows.output: Holt's side continued to press for a late victory, but McGregor countered and denied Jacobs, before Lithgow fired a shot into the corner.
rows.reference: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.

rows.source: Onye nnọchite nke Rangers Glenn Middleton nwere mkpesa maka penaliti nke abịaghị n’oge ka ya na Jacobs kụkọrọ mana Thomson lefere anya ọzọkwa.
rows.output: Rangers' midfielder Glenn Middleton had a complaint for a missed penalty that came in the 30th minute when he collided with Jacobs, but Thomson looked again and waved play on.
rows.reference: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.

rows.source: Almanak: Onye mepụtara ngụ Geiger

rows.source: N’Ugbu a otu ibe sitere na Almanak “Ụtụtụ Sọnde” anyị: Septemba 30, 1882, afọ136 gara aga taa, wee Na-agụ ... ụbọchị nke amụrụ onye nke ga-abụ onye fiziks n’ọdịnihu Johannes Wilhem “Hans” na Germany.
rows.output: Today one page from the Almanac "Sunday Morning" we: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and read ... the birthday of the one who would become the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" in Germany.
rows.reference: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.

rows.source: Geiger mepụtara ụzọ esi achọpụta ma lelee nha redioaktiviti, nchọpụta nke mechara bute ngwa a na-akpọ Ngụ Geiger.
rows.output: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, which led to the invention of the Geiger counter.
rows.reference: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.

rows.output: Since the scientific base camp, the Geiger Counter has become the new base camp for the tribe, as in the 1950 film "Bells of Coronado." The inhabitants of it were not as numerous as the scientific base camp, led by the cowboy Roy Rogers and the rancher Dale Evans:
rows.reference: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:

rows.output: They can ‘see’ the most common proteins in various plant diseases and respond to them

rows.output: Vaccination with the new vaccine has been shown to be effective in preventing typhoid fever in people of all ages.
rows.reference: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.

rows.source: Otu nwanyị ejiri ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ were gwọ, nke na-akuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ịmata selụ na-emebi ihe, hụrụ ka ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke akpa akwa ya pụrụ ihe karịrị ọnwa 18.
rows.output: A woman who used the drug to treat her, which teaches the immune system to recognize and destroy damaged cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear more than 18 months after treatment.
rows.reference: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.

rows.source: Ụzọ ahụ tinyere ịmịpụta selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa, were gbanwee ya n’ụlọ nyocha ka ha were ‘hụ’ protin na-adịkarị n’ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ a na-akpọ HER2, wee gbaghachi selụ ndị ahụ azụ.
rows.output: The process involves extracting immune cells from the patient's body, modifying them in a laboratory to express a protein that is often present in many cancer cells called HER2, and then reintroducing the cells into the body.
rows.reference: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.

rows.source: Ọkammụta Jay Berzofsky nke US National Cancer Institute dị na Bethesda Maryland, kwuru: “Ndapụta anyị na-egosi na anyị nwere ọgwụ mgbochi nyere afọ ojuju.”
rows.output: Dr. Jay Berzofsky, a professor at the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our findings suggest that we have a promising preventive therapy."
rows.reference: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."

rows.source: HER2 ”na-akwa uto nke ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ,” tinyere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke ara, akpa akwa, ngu na ọwa nsi, Ọkammụta Berzofsky kọwara.
rows.output: HER2 "is overexpressed in many types of cancer," including breast cancer, ovarian cancer, lung cancer, and esophageal cancer, Dr. Berzofsky explained.
rows.reference: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.

rows.output: The method of removing the immune cells from the body of the patient taught them to identify the cancerous cells that had been working to treat a certain type of bone cancer.
rows.reference: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.

rows.output: Kanye West made a surprise appearance at the concert venue during Saturday Night Live after his controversial performance of "Runaway" with Jay-Z, in which he rapped about his support for Donald Trump, the U.S. president, and said he would run for president in 2020.

rows.source: Ebe ọ bụ ihe nkiti gọọmentị mba ofesi itinye mgbasa ozi iji kwalite ahịa, Beijing na Washington nọ na ndọrọndọrọ azụmahịa na-abawanye nke megoro ka ha tinye ụtụ ngwahịa na ahịa mbubadata ha.
rows.output: While the foreign government's advertising campaign to promote trade is a source of increasing commercial friction, Beijing and Washington are in a trade war that has made them impose tariffs on imported goods.
rows.reference: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.

rows.source: Ntinye ụtụ ngwahịa nke China mere na mbido agha azụmahịa ka emebere ka ọ metụta ndị na ebupu ahịa n’obodo dịka Iowa kwadoro otu ndọrọndọrọ Repọblikan nke Trump, ndị ọkammara China na U.S kwuru.
rows.output: The entry of Chinese goods into the US market, which was designed to affect exporters from countries like Iowa, was supported by Republican candidates like Trump, according to Chinese experts and U.S.
rows.reference: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.

rows.source: Terry Branstad, onye nnọchite anya U.S na China bụkwa onye chịburu Iowa, onye mbupu ahịa nri ubi nke ukwuu na China, kwuru na China merụrụ ndị ọrụ, ndị ọrụ ugbo na azụmahịa nke America ahụ.
rows.output: Terry Branstad, the U.S. trade representative to China and former governor of Iowa, a major agricultural export market to China, said that China has harmed American workers, farmers, and businesses.
rows.reference: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.

rows.source: China, Branstad dere n’echiche ya na Des Moines Register na Sọnde, “na-ekwusi ike maka mmegide ahụ site na itinye mgbasa ozi n’akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi anyị.”
rows.output: China, Branstad wrote in his column for the Des Moines Register on Sunday, "emphasized the repression by putting ads in our publications."
rows.reference: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."

rows.source: “N’ịgbasa ozi asị a, gọọmentị China na ewere oghere omenala America hụrụ n’anya bụ nke onye kwuo uche ya na mgbasa ozi enweghị mkpagbu were tinye mgbasa ozi akwụrụ ụgwọ na Des Moines Register.” Branstad dere.
rows.output: “In disseminating this false information, the Chinese government has taken advantage of the cherished freedom of the press in America, which is based on the principle of the free press, and has inserted paid advertising in the Des Moines Register.” Branstad wrote.
rows.reference: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.

rows.source: “Ma ịtụlee ya n’ọdụ akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi dị n’okporo beijing ebe a, ịga ahụ na enwere obere olu ndịiche nke na ịghaghị ahụ ihe n’egosi n’ezie echiche di iche ndị China nwere ike nwee maka usoro akụnụba China nọ na nsogbu, ebe ọ bụ n’ụlọ mgbasa ozi nọ na njikwa nke China Communist Party,” ọ dere.
rows.output: "But look at the media coverage in Beijing, and you'll see that there's a small but growing number of voices that are willing to challenge the government's narrative. This is a sign that there is a growing awareness of the problems with China's economic system, and that there are people who are willing to speak out against it."
rows.reference: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.

rows.source: Ọ gbakwunyere na “otu n’ime akwụkwọ akụkọ ama ama na China zenarịrị ibiputa” ederede ya, n’agbanyeghị na o kwughị akwụkwọ akụkọ nke ọ bụ.
rows.output: He added that "one of the most popular Chinese novels ever published" was his own writings, although he did not mention the novel.
rows.reference: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.

rows.source: Ndị Repọblikan Na-akpachapụ Ndị Ntuli Aka Ụmụ-nwanyị Tupu Ntuli Aka Ọkara Ọchịchị Maka Ọgbaghara Kavanaugh, Ndị Nyocha Dọrọ Aka na Ntị
rows.output: Republican Women's Group Prioritizes Female Voters Ahead of Midterm Elections Amid Kavanaugh Controversy, Pollsters Predict Increased Turnout

rows.source: Dị ka ọtụtụ ndị isi Repọblikan kwụnyere ma kwuchitere Onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh n’ihu ebubo dị iche iche nke mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị, ndị nyocha adọọla aka na ntị na ha ga-ahụ ndapụta iwe ga-esite ọkachasị n’aka ụmụ-nwanyị, n’oge ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị na-abịa.
rows.output: Like many Republican leaders, I have strongly supported and defended Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of various allegations of sexual misconduct, and I have been warned by investigators that we can expect even more explosive revelations as we approach the mid-term elections.
rows.reference: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.

rows.source: Mmetụta sochiri nke a dị elu nke ukwuu, na ọtụtụ ndị Repọblikan ka edekọbara na ha egosila na ha chọrọ ịga n’ihu mee ntuli aka.
rows.output: The aftermath of this was extremely high, and many Republican politicians have been recorded as saying that they want to go ahead and make the election.
rows.reference: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.

rows.source: Enweghị ike iweghachi ihe ndị ahụ,” Grant Reeher, onye ọkammụta nke sayensị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na Syracuse University Maxwell School gwara The Hill maka ederede nke ebiputara na Satọde.
rows.output: The things cannot be restored," said Grant Reeher, a political science professor at Syracuse University's Maxwell School, to The Hill for an article published on Saturday.

rows.source: Reeher kwuru na ya na-agbagha n’ọkwụkwa ikpeazụ nke Onye Ọmebe Iwu Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) mere maka nyocha FBI a ga-ezu iji wetuo iwe ndị ntuli aka.
rows.output: Reeher stated that he disagreed with the final amendment of Senator Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) made for the FBI's comprehensive investigation to curb voter fraud.
rows.reference: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.

rows.source: “Ụmụ-nwanyị agaghị echefu ihe mere ụnyahụ - ha agaghị echefu echi niile ma Nọvemba, “ Karine Jean-Pierre, onye ndụmọdụ senịọ na onye nkwuchite okwu obodo maka otu ọganihu MoveOn kwuru na Fraịde, dabere na akwụkwọ akụkọ Washington, D.C.
rows.output: "Women will not forget what happened yesterday - they will not forget every day and November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a Senate adviser and spokesperson for the progressive group MoveOn, said on Friday, based on a report by the Washington Post.

rows.source: N’ụtụtụ Fraịde, ndị ngagharị iwe kwere ukwe “Nọvemba na-abịa!” ka ha na-agagharị ngagharị iwe n’ogologo ụzọ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu ebe ndị Repọblikan ji Ọgbakọ Ọka Ikpe họrọ ịga n’ihu na nhọrọ Kavanaugh agbanyeghị nkwuputa Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic kwuputara.
rows.output: On Friday morning, protesters chanted "November is coming!" as they marched through the streets of Washington, D.C. The Republican-controlled Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, who accused him of sexual assault.
rows.reference: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.

rows.source: “Ịnụ ọkụ n’obi na mkpalite mmụọ nke Demokrat ga-apụ iche,” Stu Rothenberg, onye nyocha ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị enweghị otu o binyere gwara ndị akụkọ.
rows.output: "Voter enthusiasm for Democrats is going to be hard to match," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told reporters.
rows.reference: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.

rows.source: “Ndị mmadụ na-ekwu na ọ dịla elu; nke a bụ eziokwu.
rows.output: "People say it's getting more and more difficult; this is true.

rows.source: Mana ọ nwere ike ịgbagokwu ọkachasị n’etiti ụmụ-nwanyị n’enweghị otu ha binyere n’ime obodo yana ndị ntuli aka na-etolite etolite, gbara afọ 18- ruo 29-, bụ ndị ebe onye isi ala anaghị amasị, anaghị eme ntuli aka kwa mgbe.”
rows.output: But it can be even more pronounced among young women in countries where there is no political party representation and where the president is not popular, and where there is a high rate of youth participation, aged 18 to 29.

rows.source: Ọbụlagodi tupu nkwuputanke ọha Ford mere na-akọwa ebubo mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị megide onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe kachasị Elu, ndị nyocha na-atụ elo na ndapụta iwe nwere ike sote ma ọ bụrụ na ndị Repọblikan gaa n’ihu mee nkwado ahụ.
rows.output: Even before Ford's public statement, describing the allegations of sexual misconduct against the Supreme Court nominee, investigators were suggesting that the outcome might be affected if Republicans continued to support the candidate.
rows.reference: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.

rows.source: “Nke a abụrụla ọgbaghara dịịrị GOP,” Michael Steele kwuru, onye isi chịburu Ọgbakọ Otu Repọblikan, na mbido izug ara aga, dabere na NBC News.
rows.output: "This has been a disaster for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, in an early morning interview with NBC News.
